$comment: 语法大厅 G43（V0.9 P4 精修层首课）。比喻锚点：排练时「假设走一遍」，不是真演出。只讲虚拟语气初步（If I were you / I wish + 过去式 / 现在空想型 If+过去式,would+原形），与 G35 真条件句划清边界；过去的空想（If I had done）点到为止留给高中。精修层配色紫。KET 明确不考（备考知识库列在「明确不碰」），据实标注不制造焦虑。全部内容原创。
title: 虚拟语气初步（If I were you / I wish）
metaphor: 排练时「假设走一遍」，不是真演出
ketNote: 老实说：KET 完全不考虚拟语气——备考知识库把它列在「明确不碰」一栏。这一课是为初中/PET 打底：现在弄懂「假设走一遍」，将来课本讲到虚拟语气时就是复习。不用焦虑，学到就是赚到。

sections.essence: 假设走一遍：动词集体退一步用过去式，宣布「这不是真的」。
sections.why: 中文说「如果明天下雨」和「如果我是你」，动词长得一模一样，真假全靠听的人自己掂量。英语不肯这么含糊：可能发生的假设，用 G35 学过的真条件句（if + 一般现在，主句 will）；不可能发生、纯属空想的假设，动词要集体退一步——if 从句用过去式（be 一律 were），主句用 would/could 加原形。这个「退一步」跟过去时间毫无关系，它是一枚「非现实」印章：动词一退，听的人立刻明白你在排练厅里走戏，不是在台上真演。I wish 后面也是同一枚印章——愿望落空，动词退一步。
sections.metaphorStory: 银帆乐队排练厅里，指挥拍拍谱架：「下面这段，假设我们已经站在决赛舞台上，走一遍。」灯没开、观众席空着，可大家煞有介事地鞠躬、起奏——人人都知道这不是真演出。学徒问：「英语怎么区分真演出和走戏？」指挥说：「看动词的衣服。真演出穿常服：If it rains tomorrow, we will move inside——明天真可能下雨。走戏要换礼服：动词退一步穿过去式——If I were you, I would practise more——我永远变不成你，纯属假设走一遍。」学徒又问：「为什么是 were？I 后面不该配 was 吗？」指挥笑：「这件礼服是老祖宗传下来的，不分人称，人人穿 were——一听到 If I were，台下就知道：灯是暗的，戏是走的，事是空想的。」

cards.rule: 先分真假：可能发生的用真条件，空想才退一步
cards.detail: 可能发生 → G35 的真条件句（if + 一般现在，主句 will）。不可能、纯想象 → 虚拟：if + 过去式，主句 would/could + 原形。
cards.example: If it rains, we will stay in.（可能）／ If I had wings, I would fly home.（空想）

cards.rule: 空想现在的事：If + 过去式，would/could + 动词原形
cards.detail: 退一步的过去式管的不是时间，是「非现实」。主句配 would（会）或 could（能），后面永远接原形。
cards.example: If I knew his number, I would call him.（其实我不知道）

cards.rule: If I were you：be 一律穿 were
cards.detail: 虚拟里 be 不分人称，I/he/she/it 后面也用 were——这是全团统一的礼服，也是给建议的高频句式。
cards.example: If I were you, I would say sorry first.

cards.rule: I wish + 过去式：现在的愿望落空
cards.detail: wish 后面的从句同样退一步：wish + 过去式（be 用 were），表示「可惜不是这样」。
cards.example: I wish I had a bigger room.（现在房间小，改不了）

cards.rule: wish 管落空，hope 管盼望
cards.detail: 能实现的盼望用 hope + 一般现在/将来，不退步；一用 wish + 过去式，等于宣布「实现不了」。祝福别用错门。
cards.example: I hope you pass the exam.（真心盼你过）≠ I wish I could fly.（飞不了）

cards.rule: 边界：过去的空想是高中内容
cards.detail: 「如果当时……就好了」（If I had known... / I wish I had gone...）要再退一步用过去完成式——初中先认识，不展开，高中见。
cards.example: 本课只管「现在的空想」这一层。

basic.en: If I were you, I would practise every day.
basic.cn: 我要是你，就天天练琴。（I 也穿 were）

basic.en: If I had a million dollars, I would build a concert hall.
basic.cn: 假如我有一百万，就盖一座音乐厅。（没有）

basic.en: I wish I had a little sister.
basic.cn: 真希望我有个妹妹。（可惜没有）

basic.en: If she were here, she would help us.
basic.cn: 她要是在这儿，就会帮我们了。（她不在）

basic.en: I wish it were Saturday today.
basic.cn: 今天要是周六就好了。（可惜不是）

mid.en: If I knew the answer, I would tell you at once.
mid.cn: 我要是知道答案，马上就告诉你。（其实不知道）

mid.en: If we lived near the sea, we could swim every morning.
mid.cn: 要是我们住在海边，每天早上都能游泳。（住不了）

mid.en: I wish I could play the violin like her.
mid.cn: 真希望我能拉得像她一样好。（目前不能）

mid.en: If he studied harder, he would get better grades.
mid.cn: 他要是再用功点，成绩会更好。（言下之意：现在不够用功）

mid.en: What would you do if you were the conductor?
mid.cn: 假如你是指挥，你会怎么做？（走一遍戏）

trap.en: If it rains tomorrow, we will move the concert inside.
trap.cn: 明天要是下雨，音乐会就挪到室内。
trap.note: 明天下雨完全可能——真条件句穿常服，别看见 if 就退一步。

trap.en: If I were a bird, I would fly over the school.
trap.cn: 我要是一只鸟，就飞过学校上空。
trap.note: 人变不成鸟——空想才退一步：were + would。

trap.cn: 真希望我再高一点。（现在改不了）
trap.note: wish 后面 be 穿 were；口语有人说 was，考试写 were 最稳。

trap.en: If I knew her name, I would introduce you.
trap.cn: 我要是知道她名字，就给你介绍了。
trap.note: knew 不是「过去知道」，是「现在不知道」的礼服——退一步管真假不管时间。

trap.en: I hope you have a great trip!
trap.note: 能实现的祝福用 hope，不退步——用 wish + 过去式就成了「可惜去不成」。

trap.en: If I could sing well, I would join the choir.
trap.cn: 我要是唱得好，就加入合唱团了。
trap.note: could 是 can 的退一步——「现在不能」的空想，不是过去的能力。

redBlack.bad: If I know his number, I will call him.（其实根本不知道）
redBlack.good: If I knew his number, I would call him.
redBlack.why: 空想穿了常服——听的人以为你可能知道号码、真会打，现实被传错了。

redBlack.bad: I wish you will pass the exam.（想送祝福）
redBlack.good: I hope you pass the exam.
redBlack.why: wish 一开口就是「落空」的调子——祝福被听成遗憾，好话变丧气话，用 hope 才是盼望。

redBlack.bad: If I am you, I would apologize.
redBlack.good: If I were you, I would apologize.
redBlack.why: 「我是你」永无可能——be 必须退一步穿礼服 were。

redBlack.bad: If I were you, I will take the bus.
redBlack.good: If I were you, I would take the bus.
redBlack.why: 前半句退了一步，后半句 will 没退——主句要配 would，两边一起走戏。

redBlack.bad: I wish I have more free time.
redBlack.good: I wish I had more free time.
redBlack.why: wish 后面的愿望是落空的——动词退一步用 had。

redBlack.bad: If I would know the answer, I would tell you.
redBlack.good: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
redBlack.why: would 只站在主句里——if 从句直接用过去式，不再叠一个 would。

redBlack.bad: If she were here, she would helps us.
redBlack.good: If she were here, she would help us.
redBlack.why: would 后面永远接原形——报时的活儿 would 已经干了。

redBlack.bad: I wish I can fly like a bird.
redBlack.good: I wish I could fly like a bird.
redBlack.why: wish 后面全体退一步——can 也要退成 could。

redBlack.bad: If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
redBlack.good: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
redBlack.why: 真条件句 if 从句用一般现在替将来（G35 的老规矩）——if 里不放 will。

redBlack.bad: If I were rich, I can buy the piano.
redBlack.good: If I were rich, I could buy the piano.
redBlack.why: 从句退了主句没退——can 要退成 could，全团一起走戏。

redBlack.bad: I wish I was a little taller.（考试怕扣分）
redBlack.good: I wish I were a little taller.（口语 was 也常见）
redBlack.why: 口语里 wish...was 满街都是，意思毫不受影响——考试写 were 最稳，日常别揪着纠正。

redBlack.bad: If I were you I'd go early.（有人说必须写全 I would）
redBlack.good: I'd = I would，缩写完全合法。
redBlack.why: would 缩成 'd 是标准用法，不挡意思也不算错。

contrast.cn: 如果明天下雨……／如果我是你……（动词一个样）
contrast.en: If it rains... ／ If I were you...（动词换装）
contrast.diff: 中文真假设与空想共用一套动词，全靠语境；英语用动词退不退步当面标明真假。

contrast.cn: 要是我有翅膀就好了。（「就好了」收尾）
contrast.en: I wish I had wings.（wish + 退一步）
contrast.diff: 中文把遗憾挂在句尾的「就好了」；英语把遗憾压进动词形态里。

contrast.cn: 我要是你，就先道歉。（不用变动词）
contrast.en: If I were you, I would say sorry first.
contrast.diff: 中文靠「要是」两个字撑起假设；英语还要动词穿礼服：were + would 双保险。

contrast.cn: 祝你考试顺利！／真希望能陪你去。（都用「希望」）
contrast.en: I hope the exam goes well. ／ I wish I could go with you.
contrast.diff: 中文一个「希望」两头用；英语分家——hope 盼得到，wish 盼不到。

contrast.cn: 他要是知道，早说了。（「早」字点破）
contrast.en: If he knew, he would tell us.（knew 点破）
contrast.diff: 中文用副词暗示「其实不知道」；英语让过去式亲自出面宣布非现实。

quickJudge.mnemonic: 先问可不可能：可能穿常服（G35 真条件），空想退一步——if 过去式、be 用 were、主句 would/could 加原形。
steps: 问自己：这个假设可能成真吗？可能 → 真条件句（if + 一般现在，主句 will），到此为止。
不可能、纯空想 → if 从句动词退一步用过去式；be 不分人称一律 were。
主句配 would（会）或 could（能），后面永远接动词原形。
看到 I wish：后面的愿望默认落空——动词同样退一步（have→had，can→could，be→were）。
想送能实现的祝福？换 hope，不退步。
自查两不要：if 从句里不放 would；would/could 后面不加 -s 不报时。

parentScript.script: 「宝贝，咱们玩『空想走一遍』：我出一个绝对不可能的假设，比如『你要是校长』『你要是有一双翅膀』，你用英语说出来——If I were the headmaster... / If I had wings, I would...。我不懂英语没关系，我只当排练厅门口的检票员，听两个音：一个是 were（乌尔），一个是 would（伍德）。两个音都出现了，就是合格的『走戏』；少一个我就喊『穿帮啦，这场当真啦』。」再玩反向关：家长说一个可能发生的事（明天下雨、周末放假），孩子要故意不穿礼服，用 If it rains, we will... 说——能分清哪场是真演出、哪场是走戏，这课就通了。
questions: 「如果明天下雨」和「如果我是你」，哪个是真演出、哪个是假设走一遍？英语各怎么处理动词？
If I ___ you 里那件全人称通用的礼服是哪个词？
wish 和 hope 都是「希望」，哪个盼得到、哪个盼不到？

sections.echo: were 这件礼服，是英语虚拟式的活化石。一千多年前，古英语每个动词都有整套专门的虚拟变形；漫长的磨损之后，普通动词的虚拟式全部塌平，跟过去式长成了一个样——只有出场率最高的 be，还独自保住了 If I were 这一件老礼服。这已经是同一条定律第三次现身：G04 里 be 三词根缝合，G13 里 went 借来不还，这里 were 独守虚拟式——越常用的词，越有资格不随大流。再看 would：它本是 will 的过去式，退一步既能表虚拟（本课），也能表客气（G38 的弱奏），还能转述过去（G40 的退一步）——「离现实远一点」这一个动作，英语用它做出了三种表情。

stages.name: 认一认 · 真演出还是走一遍

questions.q: If I were you, I would practise more. 这句是真演出还是假设走一遍？
options: 假设走一遍——我永远变不成你
questions.explain: 「我是你」永无可能——动词退一步穿礼服，纯属空想。

questions.q: If it rains tomorrow, we will stay at home. 这句是真条件还是空想？
options: 真条件——明天下雨完全可能
questions.explain: 可能发生的假设穿常服：if + 一般现在，主句 will（G35 的老规矩）。

questions.q: 虚拟语气里动词「退一步」表示什么？
questions.explain: 退一步是一枚「非现实」印章，管真假不管时间。

questions.q: 虚拟语气里，be 动词不分人称一律用？
questions.explain: If I were you——这件礼服全团统一，人人穿 were。

questions.q: 空想现在的事，主句要配哪对搭档？
questions.explain: 从句退一步，主句配 would/could，后面永远原形。

questions.q: I wish 后面的愿望，默认是什么状态？
options: 落空——实现不了才用 wish
questions.explain: wish 一开口就是遗憾的调子，动词跟着退一步。

questions.q: 「盼得到」的希望，该用哪个词开头？
questions.explain: hope 管能实现的盼望，不退步；wish 管落空的愿望。

questions.q: I wish I could fly. 里的 could 是谁退的一步？
questions.explain: wish 后面全体退一步——can 退成 could，表「现在不能」。

questions.q: If I knew her name... 里的 knew 表示？
questions.explain: 退一步管真假不管时间——knew 是「现在不知道」的礼服。

questions.q: 下面哪一句是空想（虚拟语气）？
options: If I had four hands, I would play two pianos.
If you finish early, we will play chess.
When it snows, the roof turns white.
questions.explain: 人长不出四只手——had + would，礼服齐全。

questions.q: If I were the conductor, I would choose a faster song. 说话人是指挥吗？
options: 不是——正因为不是才这么说
questions.explain: were 已经宣布「非现实」——说话人不是指挥，在走戏。

questions.q: 「假设走一遍」的礼服穿在哪两处？
options: if 从句退一步 + 主句 would/could
questions.explain: 两边一起走戏：从句过去式，主句 would/could + 原形。

questions.q: I wish it were Sunday. 今天是周日吗？
options: 不是——wish 后面的事都落空
questions.explain: wish + were 宣布愿望落空——今天偏偏不是周日。

questions.q: would 后面的动词该用什么形式？
questions.explain: 报时的活儿 would 干了——后面永远原形。

questions.q: 「If + 一般现在，主句 will」这套常服出自哪一课？
options: G35 状语从句（真条件句）
questions.explain: 真条件句是 G35 的舞台提示——本课管的是它的空想兄弟。

questions.q: 下面哪一句用 wish 用对了？
options: I wish I had a time machine.
I wish you a nice weekend pass the exam.
I wish to knew the answer.
questions.explain: 时光机造不出来——wish + had，标准的落空愿望。

stages.name: 选一选 · 退一步穿礼服

questions.q: If I ___ you, I would take an umbrella.
questions.explain: 「我是你」纯属空想——be 穿全人称礼服 were。

questions.q: If I ___ a bird, I would fly to the sea.
questions.explain: 人变不成鸟——空想退一步，were。

questions.q: If she ___ here, she would know what to do.
questions.explain: 她不在这儿——虚拟里 she 后面也用 were。

questions.q: If I had more time, I ___ learn the guitar.
questions.explain: 从句退了一步，主句配 would——两边一起走戏。

questions.q: If we lived near the school, we ___ walk there every day.
questions.explain: 空想的「能」——can 退成 could。

questions.q: I wish I ___ more free time on weekdays.
questions.explain: wish 后面的愿望落空——have 退成 had。

questions.q: I wish I ___ sing as well as the lead singer.
questions.explain: 现在唱不到那么好——can 退一步用 could。

questions.q: I wish today ___ my birthday.
questions.explain: 可惜今天不是生日——wish 后 be 用 were。

questions.q: If he ___ the answer, he would put up his hand.
questions.explain: 他其实不会——know 退成 knew，宣布非现实。

questions.q: If I ___ a million dollars, I would build a library.
questions.explain: 没有一百万——had 是空想的礼服。

questions.q: What ___ you do if you were the headmaster for one day?
questions.explain: 当一天校长是走戏——疑问句里也用 would。

questions.q: If it ___ tomorrow, the match will be put off.（明天真可能下雨）
questions.explain: 可能发生穿常服——真条件句 if + 一般现在。

questions.q: I ___ you pass the driving test this Friday.（真心盼你过）
questions.explain: 盼得到的祝福用 hope，不退步。

questions.q: If they were here, they ___ us move the piano.
questions.explain: would + 原形 help——报时的活儿 would 已经干了。

questions.q: If I ___ where the key was, I would open the door myself.
questions.explain: 不知道钥匙在哪——knew 退一步表非现实。

questions.q: I wish my grandma ___ closer to us.
questions.explain: 奶奶住得远，改不了——live 退成 lived。

questions.q: 哪一句的礼服穿对了？（我要是你就先道歉）
options: If I were you, I would say sorry first.
If I am you, I would say sorry first.
If I were you, I will say sorry first.
questions.explain: were + would 两件礼服都要穿齐——am 和 will 都是常服。

questions.q: 哪一句说对了？（真希望我能多睡一小时）
options: I wish I could sleep one more hour.
I wish I can sleep one more hour.
I hope I could sleep one more hour.
questions.explain: wish 后面 can 退成 could；hope 不跟退步的 could 搭。

questions.q: 哪一句的 if 从句写对了？（我要是知道就告诉你）
options: If I knew the answer, I would tell you.
If I would know the answer, I would tell you.
If I know the answer, I would tell you.
questions.explain: if 从句里不放 would——直接退一步用 knew。

questions.q: 哪一句主句写对了？（她要是在，会帮我们）
options: If she were here, she would help us.
If she were here, she would helps us.
If she were here, she helps us.
questions.explain: would 后面永远原形——helps 的 -s 是多报了一次时。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（今天要是不上学就好了）
options: I wish we didn't have school today.
I wish we don't have school today.
I wish we won't have school today.
questions.explain: wish 后面退一步——don't 退成 didn't。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（明天下雨我们就取消野餐——真可能下）
options: If it rains tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
If it will rain tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
If it rained tomorrow, we will cancel the picnic.
questions.explain: 真条件句穿常服：if + 一般现在——if 里不放 will，也别乱退步。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（我要是有钱就能买那把吉他）
options: If I were rich, I could buy that guitar.
If I were rich, I can buy that guitar.
If I am rich, I could buy that guitar.
questions.explain: 两边一起退：were 配 could——一边常服一边礼服就穿帮了。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（祝你比赛顺利）
options: I hope the match goes well for you.
I wish the match went well for you.
I wish the match goes well.
questions.explain: 盼得到的祝福用 hope + 现在——wish + went 成了「可惜赢不了」。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（他要是住得近点，我们就能常见面）
options: If he lived nearer, we could meet more often.
If he lives nearer, we could meet more often.
If he lived nearer, we can meet more often.
questions.explain: lived + could 成套——常服礼服不混穿。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（真希望现在是暑假）
options: I wish it were the summer holiday now.
I wish it is the summer holiday now.
I hope it were the summer holiday now.
questions.explain: 落空的愿望：wish + were；hope 不穿礼服。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（你要是校长，会改什么规定？）
options: If you were the headmaster, what rule would you change?
If you are the headmaster, what rule would you change?
If you were the headmaster, what rule will you change?
questions.explain: 当校长是走戏——were 与 would 配套出场。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（我要是有一双翅膀就飞回家）
options: If I had wings, I would fly home.
If I have wings, I would fly home.
If I had wings, I will fly home.
questions.explain: 长不出翅膀——had + would，两件礼服齐。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（真希望我的字写得像她一样好看）
options: I wish my handwriting were as nice as hers.
I wish my handwriting is as nice as hers.
I wish my handwriting will be as nice as hers.
questions.explain: wish 后 be 穿 were——现在改不了的遗憾。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（要是没有作业，我就天天练琴）
options: If there were no homework, I would practise every day.
If there is no homework, I would practise every day.
If there were no homework, I will practise every day.
questions.explain: There be 也要退一步——were + would 配套。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（他要是不那么忙，就会来听音乐会）
options: If he weren't so busy, he would come to the concert.
If he isn't so busy, he would come to the concert.
If he weren't so busy, he comes to the concert.
questions.explain: 否定也穿礼服——weren't + would。

questions.q: 哪一句写对了？（真希望自己能帮上忙——可惜帮不上）
questions.explain: 帮不上的遗憾：wish + could；hope 后面不接退步的 could。

questions.q: 同桌忘带午饭很沮丧，你想给建议：「我要是你，就先给妈妈打电话。」怎么说？
options: If I were you, I would call your mum first.
If I am you, I will call your mum first.
If I was you, I will call your mum.
questions.explain: 给建议的高频句式——If I were you, I would...

questions.q: If I ___ near the concert hall, I ___ to every show.
questions.explain: 住不到那儿——lived 配 would go，两边一起退。

questions.q: 朋友明天考试，你想说句吉利话，选哪句？
options: I hope you do well tomorrow!
I wish you did well tomorrow!
If you were lucky, you would pass.
questions.explain: 盼得到的祝福用 hope——另两句都带着「悬了」的调子。

questions.q: — What would you do if you ___ a whole free day? — I would read all morning.
questions.explain: 问答都在走戏——had 与 would 呼应。

questions.q: If our classroom ___ bigger, we ___ put a piano in it.
questions.explain: 教室大小改不了——were 配 could 成套。

questions.q: 看着窗外的雨，走不了了，你叹气说：
options: I wish it weren't raining so hard.
I hope it weren't raining so hard.
I wish it isn't raining so hard.
questions.explain: 改变不了的现状——wish + weren't。

questions.q: 下面哪句「真假」用对了？（周五真有可能放假）
options: If we have no class on Friday, we will visit the museum.
If we had no class on Friday, we will visit the museum.
If we have no class on Friday, we would visit the museum.
questions.explain: 可能发生就全穿常服——have 配 will，不混搭。

questions.q: 爷爷家太远，一年只见一次。你说：
options: I wish Grandpa lived closer to us.
I hope Grandpa lived closer to us.
I wish Grandpa lives closer to us.
questions.explain: 住址改不了——wish + lived。

questions.q: If everyone in the world ___ the same language, travelling ___ much easier.
questions.explain: 全世界说一种语言是空想——spoke 配 would be。

questions.q: — I wish I ___ taller. — You're still growing! Don't worry.
questions.explain: 此刻的身高改不了——wish + were（口语 was 也常听到，考试写 were）。

questions.q: 选出「真条件 + 空想」都用对的一组：
options: If it snows, we will make a snowman. / If I were a bird, I would fly.
If it snowed, we will make a snowman. / If I am a bird, I would fly.
If it snows, we would make a snowman. / If I were a bird, I will fly.
questions.explain: 真条件穿常服（snows+will），空想穿礼服（were+would）——各归各位。

questions.q: If I ___ how to cook, I ___ dinner for the whole family.
questions.explain: 不会做饭——knew 配 would make。

questions.q: 音乐会门票太贵买不起，你说：
options: If the tickets weren't so expensive, I would go.
If the tickets aren't so expensive, I will go.
If the tickets weren't so expensive, I will go.
questions.explain: 票价改不了——weren't 配 would，整套礼服。

questions.q: — Why don't you join the choir? — I ___ if I ___ better.
questions.explain: 言下之意「我唱得不够好」——would 配 sang。

questions.q: 下面哪句最能听出「说话人现在没有宠物」？
options: I wish I had a dog.
I hope I have a dog.
questions.explain: wish + had 宣布愿望落空——现在没有狗。

questions.q: 大考：If I ___ you, I ___ the teacher, because if she ___ the truth tomorrow, she will understand.
questions.explain: 前半是空想（were+would tell），后半「明天听到真相」真有可能——真条件穿常服 hears。一句里两种假设各穿各的衣服。

detective.sentence: If I am you, I would ask the teacher for help.
detective.fixed: If I were you, I would ask the teacher for help.
detective.clue: 「我是你」永无可能——be 要穿全人称礼服 were，am 是常服。

detective.sentence: I wish I can play basketball as well as my cousin.
detective.fixed: I wish I could play basketball as well as my cousin.
detective.clue: wish 后面全体退一步——can 要退成 could。

detective.sentence: If she were here, she will show us the new song.
detective.fixed: If she were here, she would show us the new song.
detective.clue: 从句退了一步主句没退——will 要退成 would，两边一起走戏。

detective.sentence: I wish I have a seat by the window.
detective.fixed: I wish I had a seat by the window.
detective.clue: wish 后面的愿望是落空的——have 退成 had。

detective.sentence: If I would have a bike, I would ride to school.
detective.fixed: If I had a bike, I would ride to school.
detective.clue: would 只站在主句里——if 从句直接退一步用 had。

detective.sentence: If he knew the way, he would leads us there.
detective.fixed: If he knew the way, he would lead us there.
detective.clue: would 后面永远原形——leads 的 -s 是多报的一次时。

detective.sentence: I wish you will have a good time at the party tomorrow.
detective.fixed: I hope you have a good time at the party tomorrow.
detective.clue: 盼得到的祝福归 hope 管——wish 一开口就是「实现不了」的调子。
